visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A green and blue light rail train moves quickly across the screen from right to left on a track surrounded by manicured green grass. In the background are tall, multi-story residential buildings with beige and brown walls, featuring multiple balconies and visible air conditioning units under a bright afternoon sky. (2) A man with short black hair, wearing a casual black T-shirt and blue jeans, walks away from the camera toward the entrance of a restaurant. The building has a modern industrial look with a white bicycle parked outside and a glowing white sign with black calligraphy reading "墨岩" beside the glass door. (3) Inside the restaurant, a bartender wearing a black face mask and matching black shirt holds up two tall frosted glasses filled with an amber liquid and ice cubes toward the camera. The background is dimly lit, showcasing a bar area with refrigerators and various bottles on high shelves. (4) A wide spread of Japanese-style dishes is presented on a dark wooden table, including numerous skewers on stone plates, a large bowl of steamed clams, and a vibrant green vegetable salad. The professional lighting is warm and bright, highlighting the textures and steam rising from the hot food. (5) In a professional kitchen, a chef in a black shirt tosses ingredients in a pan, creating a sudden, dramatic burst of bright orange flames that fill the frame. Nearby, another chef in a black tank top and glasses meticulously flips meat skewers on a charcoal grill using tongs. (6) Extremely close-up shots of specific dishes are shown: stir-fried eggs covered in a dense layer of moving bonito flakes, sake-steamed clams served in a wooden bowl with sliced green onions, and a green fern salad topped with a mound of bright red mentaiko. (7) Detailed close-ups of various grilled skewers are presented sequentially: charred chicken wings with glistening skin, meat skewers garnished with fresh green onions, and vegetable skewers featuring bright green grilled peppers and okra, all presented on decorative ceramic plates. (8) The camera pans across the interior of the izakaya, showing a clean, U-shaped wooden bar counter with place settings. Small photos and postcards are clipped to a line above the bar, and a chef is visible working in the background under soft pendant lighting. (9) A wide shot of the light rail station at dusk shows a train at the platform under a purple-streaked sky with a red bridge in the distance. The final shot shows the restaurant's exterior at night with a large text overlay providing the address and contact details.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with the mechanical whirring and rolling sound of a light rail train passing on tracks, providing a distinct urban ambient noise. No vocals or music are present yet, focusing the listener's attention on the physical environment of the scene. (2) A male narrator with a friendly and enthusiastic tone begins speaking. Simultaneously, an upbeat, mid-tempo acoustic pop song featuring a steady acoustic guitar strumming pattern and a light percussion beat enters the mix. The music has a positive, major-key tonality that creates an inviting atmosphere. (3) A sudden, loud "whoosh" sound effect is layered in as the narration mentions cooking, representing the ignition of a gas burner. This is immediately followed by a continuous, high-frequency sizzling sound from a hot pan, indicating active stir-frying and adding a sense of heat to the audio. (4) The sound of ice cubes clinking against the sides of glass mugs is clearly audible, synchronized with the visual of drinks being served. The narrator maintains a consistent, clear articulation and a moderate speech rate, conveying a sense of recommendation and personal discovery. (5) Short, percussive sounds of skewers being placed on plates and the subtle scraping of chopsticks are interspersed throughout the description of the menu. The background music remains at a constant level, providing a cheerful energy without masking the narrator's voice. (6) The narration reaches a concluding tone with a higher pitch and positive valence. The music swells slightly for a final cadence before a hard cut to the ending. The ambient sound of the train from the opening returns briefly as the track fades to silence.
